decision.integration_finding: runner.py:120-144 loads archive snapshot, builds handoff, then atomically writes anata_latest.json without snapshot-generation admission. Older A can theoretically overwrite newer B at identical as_of_ms. Existing atomic visibility test only checks complete JSON, not freshness. This is source-derived and NOT reproduced. Original 2026-10-14 three-file generation oracle is not established as an Anata consumer requirement.
decision.substantive_A_lane_decision: No further source-only test contract churn and no Gemini task. Maintain pinned bounded two-process, equal-clock single-handoff regression as the next required evidence. New public HEAD would invalidate validation and verdicts.
decision.acceptance: At same fixed T, A pauses before writing anata_latest after reading old archive; append PIT rowB; B publishes handoff with rowB source_record_id; release A; final handoff must retain B. Assert both exitcodes 0, no archive duplicate, bounded event timeouts, test overlay hash and exact checkout SHA; preserve actual red/green logs.
decision.next_feasible_recovery: Provision authorized disposable exact-SHA checkout or independent CI runner; run pinned no-network overlay, targeted and full Capital Flow pytest, retain logs/non-skipped counts; Planner C independently audits.
